the problem of how to provide seamless access to heterogeneous wireless networks, with a focus on the handoff decision process.
developing the necessary infrastructure to enable the seamless integration of heterogeneous wireless networks.
the design of a handoff system that can be used to implement policies for selecting the most appropriate network.

we have developed an architecture for policy-enabled handoff across wireless networks that allows users to specify their own policies for handoff, and that we have designed a system for estimating current network performance, that is, a network monitoring system, which serves as the input to our policy-enabled handoff mechanism.

we have designed, prototyped, and evaluated a system that enables mobile users to express their network policies, while balancing the load among wireless systems.
the Daedalus system is a complete end-to-end solution for seamless mobility across heterogeneous wireless networks with the goal of balancing network load.
